purpose: An orientation map of the historic trail, not directions, an access map, or a current race route.
recommendedVisibleCaption: Historic trail overview · BLM route, Natural Earth coastline. For orientation only; not a navigation map.
routeScope: This BLM centerline represents the historic route. Its source explicitly excludes connecting routes and the dog sled race route. The historic network is broader than this single displayed alignment.

editorialNotes.text: BLM describes a 1,000-mile main trail between Seward and Nome plus 1,400 miles of side and connecting trails. Do not label the single displayed alignment as the whole 2,400-mile network.
The network crosses lands under multiple public and private owners. A line on this orientation map is not a statement of permission, safe conditions, or continuous year-round access.

IHTA describes the trail as primarily a winter trail and highlights summer trails in Chugach State Park, Chugach National Forest, Girdwood and Eagle River. Seasonal controls should change the visitor recommendations rather than imply this whole historic alignment is a summer hiking route.
The BLM brochure distinguishes the main historic route, connecting historic routes and race routes as three separate map layers. The SVG here contains only the first.

Girdwood and Crow Pass are geographically close at this map scale. Use one Southcentral cluster pin, reveal details in a panel, or offset only the label with a leader line; do not move the geographic marker.
